**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry** in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3). 380 commits, 12 user-facing.

Four are breaking. The v1 export route is gone. Error types stopped being re-exported from five modules. Expired tokens return `401`, not `403`. The latency histogram units changed.

One feature: webhook retries with backoff. Eight real fixes, including one that stopped logging request bodies.

Two calls I made. Perf work got cut, since your three headings have no slot for it. And `docs: note the minimum node version` landed five times with CI moving to node 22, but no `engines` change in any diff.

Next: tell me the real min node version if it moved. That belongs under Breaking.
